# Axisymmetric coil reference v1

This 10 mm by 10 mm r-z linear-air model has a 12 A, one-turn series circuit
and zero potential on its outer boundary and symmetry axis. The frozen answer
was generated by unmodified stock FEMM 4.2; `freeze_reference.lua` documents
the procedure and circuit-property export.

The generic artifact is generated from the same `.fem` with the standalone
mesh-only preparer. The regression compares nodal poloidal flux by coordinate
and circuit flux linkage. Its limits are 0.3% relative L2 for the nodal
potential and 0.1% for flux linkage. The measured differences are caused by
the solver's conventional P1 A-phi basis versus FEMM's specialized r-squared
axisymmetric interpolation.

The stock FEMM installation is a read-only input. It is not copied into this
fixture and is never modified by the test.
